before.description_1: Werken bij EFE needed a website that answered practical visitor questions more quickly. The recruitment offer had to be explained with clear context, useful detail, and a visible route to contact. With a tighter structure, the page feels less generic and easier to assess on both desktop and mobile.
before.description_2: I refined the page by reducing repetition, improving the order of information, and making each section easier to scan. The WordPress build presents the recruitment offer with practical context and steady pacing. Visitors now get clearer reasons to continue, compare the work, and start a conversation.

after.description_1: Werken bij EFE combines a large vacancy offer with employer information, core values, reviews and practical context about working at EFE. The challenge was to keep job discovery central while still giving candidates enough information about development, working conditions and the organisation before they apply.
after.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around the candidate journey: browse vacancies, open a role, understand the employer and move into a clear application route. Separate company, service and review content supports that journey without distracting from the vacancies, while the responsive layout keeps the same hierarchy on mobile.

before.description_1: RBMB needed a webshop that made its product range easier to understand and navigate. Visitors had to quickly find the right building materials, compare relevant product categories, and feel confident before making an inquiry or purchase.
before.description_2: I created a more complete WooCommerce webshop experience with clear sections, improved product presentation, and practical conversion points throughout the customer journey. The webshop now explains the offer more clearly, supports visitors with better context, and makes it easier to move from product discovery to contact or purchase. This gives RBMB a stronger online presence and a more reliable path for potential customers.

after.description_1: RBMB sells professional building materials for floors, walls and finishing, across categories such as egaline, mortar, primer, floor coatings, plastering products, adhesives, tools and insulation. The webshop therefore needed category depth without making product discovery feel complicated for professionals or capable DIY customers.
after.description_2: I organised the WooCommerce experience around clear categories, product search, product detail and practical buying support. Advice content and contact options sit close to the assortment, so visitors can move from identifying the right material to ordering or asking for help without losing context.

before.description_1: Enspect needed project content that is easier to read and more useful for quick comparison. The page had to explain the inspection work without heavy language, while giving visitors enough context to understand the service, trust the presentation and decide whether to get in touch.
before.description_2: I shaped the page around what visitors need to know first: the offer, the benefit and the next step. Short sections, cleaner wording and focused WordPress delivery make the inspection project easier to judge. The page now feels more specific, useful and ready for inquiries.

after.description_1: Enspect specialises in electrical inspections such as SCIOS Scope 8, 10 and 12, NEN 1010, NEN 3140 and thermography, alongside engineering and technical advice. The website needed to explain these different inspection routes clearly for companies that may be working from insurer, safety or compliance requirements.
after.description_2: I structured the WordPress content around the inspection types, practical process and next step. Technical subjects are broken into readable service pages with clear context, while quote access and supporting knowledge content help visitors understand which inspection fits their situation before making contact.

before.description_1: Before the update, Leeuwbeveiliging needed sharper page content because important security details were not always clear at first glance. Visitors needed a stronger introduction, better section flow, and wording that explained the offer in normal language before they committed to contacting the business. It made the next step clearer sooner.
before.description_2: I gave Leeuwbeveiliging a clearer structure with sharper English copy, logical content blocks, and a smoother route from introduction to contact. The page explains the security work without extra noise, helps visitors compare faster, and keeps the WordPress presentation consistent across screen sizes. It made the next step clearer sooner.

after.description_1: Leeuw Beveiliging needed a professional WordPress presentation that makes its security offer understandable quickly and gives business visitors confidence before they make contact. The project called for clear service language, visible credibility and a direct route from first impression to enquiry.
after.description_2: I organised the page around the security offer, trust information and the next action instead of repeating general sales language. Shorter content blocks and a consistent responsive structure make the services easier to scan and keep contact options visible across desktop and mobile.

before.description_1: Doctorcura needed a healthcare page that reduces hesitation before inquiry. Visitors were likely comparing providers, so the page had to explain the offer quickly, show relevant details and keep the next step clear. Long or general wording would have made the service feel less certain.
before.description_2: I created a more direct page flow with concise headings, specific project wording and WordPress content fields that remain easy to maintain. The design gives Doctorcura a clearer presentation, while visitors can scan the offer, understand the value and move towards contact without confusion.

after.description_1: Doctorcura is a digital healthcare platform where visitors move from treatment discovery into a structured medical process. The website needs to explain treatments, the online medical questionnaire, clinical review, pharmacy fulfilment and delivery information clearly enough for users to understand the steps before they continue.
after.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience so treatment information, process steps, FAQs and trust content remain separate but connected. Clear next actions guide visitors from choosing a treatment to the medical questionnaire, while supporting information about doctors, pharmacies and delivery stays available without overwhelming the main journey.

before.description_1: Koelcellenbouw already had useful construction information, but the message needed a calmer structure and clearer priorities. Visitors needed to scan the page, understand the practical value and see a simple route forward. The content also had to sound specific instead of broad or interchangeable.
before.description_2: I rewrote the content and organised the page so each section answers a clear visitor question. The result explains the construction work in plain English, connects benefits to real decisions and keeps contact options close. This makes the case easier to read, compare and trust.

after.description_1: Koelcellenbouw focuses on specialist B2B projects such as custom cold rooms, freezer rooms, cleanrooms and turnkey installations. The website therefore needed to present technical capabilities in a way that helps companies understand the available solutions before requesting advice or a quotation.
after.description_2: I organised the WordPress content around the main project types, practical service information and clear quotation routes. The structure keeps technical subjects readable, gives each service enough context and keeps contact options close to the points where a business visitor is ready to discuss a project.

before.description_1: Zeninspec already had useful inspection information, but the message needed a calmer structure and clearer priorities. Visitors had to scan the page, understand the practical value, and see a simple route forward. The content also needed to sound specific rather than broad or interchangeable.
before.description_2: I rewrote and organised the content so each section answers a clear visitor question. The result explains the inspection work in plain English, connects benefits to real decisions, and keeps contact options close. This makes the case easier to read, compare, and trust.

after.description_1: ZEN provides inspection, testing and certification services for oil, gas and chemical commodities, with work spanning laboratory analysis, cargo inspection, marine surveys and related quality and compliance services. The website needed to separate this broad technical offer while keeping accreditation and sector expertise visible.
after.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around distinct service areas and technical decision paths. Visitors can move from inspection, testing or certification into more specific services such as cargo inspections and marine surveys, while supporting trust information and direct quote access remain close to the content.
